name: Dr. Rin ni Kiitemite! ~Koi no Rin Feng-Shui~
original_name: Dr.リンにきいてみて! 〜恋のリン風水〜
source: The protagonist is an original character that gets tranferred to Meirin's class. She'll help her in her love consultations, divinations and school life.
translation: 主人公是原创角色，转入梅铃的班级。她会帮助梅铃进行恋爱咨询、占卜与校园生活。
